title: Target compiler (--target-compiler)
summary: Names the oldest compiler the code must compile on; modernize findings whose advice needs a newer compiler are not reported
intro: Read this when your code must still build on an older Delphi (12, 10.4, XE7 ...): pass --target-compiler or set target_compiler in drag-lint-lint.json, and lint stops suggesting syntax that compiler cannot take.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Code Quality > Run Lint All (Full Report)...
